reviews.title: Pls NEVER download it ‼️‼️
reviews.text:
If you pay for anything without an account or app they automatically put you in a 7-day-trial version and if they are lucky enough you don’t realise that you are subscribed, overpass the one week and they can !legally! charge you for a hell lot of money.

It’s a total scam and you cannot do anything about it since you (unintentionally) agreed their terms… so i started to use the app like okay let’s make the best out of it. BAD IDEA. User interface is shady, you never know whether something costs money or not. You don’t get asked if you want to use any service for this and that amount of money etc. I didn’t even get notifications about the transactions from my bank. I just saw they took money and I don’t even know what for.

One more thing, if you want to unsubscribe it’s two different things to unsubscribe from website and app. So pay attention if you fall into this scam. Make sure on every platforms that you never owe them any more money.
reviews.reply:
Hello dear Customer!  
  
We greatly appreciate your time to leave us a review.  
 
We`re sorry to hear about your negative experience with the payment process. Please rest assured that we`re here to ensure a smoother journey for you.  
  
We want to assure you that we strive to be fully transparent about all charges, and subscription details are always provided before any payment is made. Additionally, the option to cancel is available at any time in your account settings.  
  
We want to make the payment process as clear and seamless as possible. Please contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and our team will help resolve any concerns.
  
Best regards, support team.

Its either a serious bug or a very misleading ad, i wish they admitted which.

reviews.title: SCAM! BEWARE FRADULANT CHARGES!
reviews.text: I downloaded this app thinking I was signing up for a free trial, but they charged me $50 immediately without warning. The charge went through on a different card that wasn’t even set as my default payment method. When I asked for a refund, Apple refused, and Nebula told me to deal with Apple—neither company takes responsibility! To make it worse, I didn’t even get access to the premium features I was charged for. This is a shady app using misleading payment tactics—AVOID at all costs!
